registration.note: Target is inherited, not a measured acceptance. One reviewed master registration governs the pack; authored limb envelopes and body anchors are separate.

clips.action: One soft, three-second breathing cycle. Keep the face, pelvis, and feet registered. Animate a small local chest/shoulder deformation, not a scale transform of the entire panda. No blink in this loop.
frames: Exact neutral reference pose: awake, paws relaxed beside the belly, both feet planted.
Begin the inhale: chest rises approximately 0.5 runtime pixel; head, hips, and feet stay fixed.
Inhale continues: chest rises approximately 1 runtime pixel; expression unchanged.
Chest rises approximately 1.5 runtime pixels; only a slight local shoulder response.
Soft inhale peak: chest rises approximately 2 runtime pixels; no inflated balloon belly or head enlargement.
Ease off the inhale peak: chest rise approximately 1.5 runtime pixels.
Exhale: chest rise approximately 1 runtime pixel.
Exhale continues: chest rise approximately 0.5 runtime pixel.
Pass smoothly through neutral breathing volume; do not pause or restart the action.
Small relaxed exhale: chest falls approximately 0.5 runtime pixel below neutral.
Soft exhale trough: chest falls approximately 1 runtime pixel; feet and head remain fixed.
Recover toward neutral: chest is approximately 0.5 runtime pixel below neutral. This is a genuinely different pose from frame 00, close enough to continue smoothly into it. Do not duplicate frame 00.

clips.action: One small, relaxed wave with the paw on the viewer's right. Keep the paw inside the existing head-width envelope; keep the opposite paw and both feet fixed. No whole-body squash, jumping, bowing, hearts, or sparkles.
frames: Exact neutral reference pose; both paws down, eyes open.
Viewer-right paw lifts a little toward the upper belly; elbow stays close to the body.
Paw rises beside the lower cheek, below the ear, with rounded paw pads gently facing the viewer.
Small outward wrist turn; welcoming expression but no larger head or exaggerated mouth.
Small inward wrist turn: complete the single restrained wave without changing the body position.
Paw begins lowering from the cheek toward the chest.
Paw nearly returned to the relaxed neutral position; eyes and smile return exactly to neutral.
Exact neutral reference pose, matching calm_idle frame 00 and rest. This frame will be copied from the locked neutral source during assembly.

clips.action: Reuse the approved prop-free neutral reference. No new image generation is necessary.
frames: Exact prop-free neutral reference, awake and attentive. Reuse the approved pixels; no blink, fade, breathing, or procedural motion.

clips.action: Change only the eyelids. Retain the neutral body, ears, eye-patch shapes, nose, mouth, paws, feet, camera, and light. The whole image must not be squashed to make the eyes close.
frames: Exact neutral reference; eyes fully open.
Upper eyelids half lowered over both eyes together; eye patches remain unchanged.
Eyes gently closed for this frame only; relaxed lids, no squeezed happy crescents and no cheek lift.
Eyes half reopened, reversing the eyelid action of frame 01.
Eyes fully open; exact neutral reference.
Exact neutral reference. The short open-eye tail belongs to this one-shot and is not a loop seam.

clips.action: A restrained left-to-right glance. Eyes carry most of the action; head yaw is at most about two degrees. No magnifying glass, cards, arrows, or generated code.
frames: Exact neutral reference, eyes forward.
Pupils glance a little toward the viewer's left; head and body stay centered.
Head follows the left glance with a very small yaw, no more than about two degrees.
Return through center; eyes look briefly forward.
Pupils glance a little toward the viewer's right.
Head follows the right glance by no more than about two degrees; shoulders remain level.
Eyes and head ease back toward front.
Exact neutral reference pose. Copy the locked source for the final handoff.

clips.action: Bring the viewer-left paw lightly near the chin, tilt the head a little, then return. This is a one-shot, not a pantomime that repeats for the entire task. No thought bubbles or floating dots.
frames: Exact neutral reference, relaxed and attentive.
Viewer-left paw begins lifting toward the chest.
Paw approaches the lower chin without covering the nose or mouth.
Paw rests lightly beneath the chin; head tilts about two degrees; eyes glance slightly upward.
Small thoughtful hold with the same gentle expression, no furrowed angry brows.
Head straightens while the paw begins to lower.
Paw returns toward the side of the belly; gaze comes forward.
Exact neutral reference pose; copy the locked source at assembly.

clips.action: Dif makes a small two-paw presentation gesture toward the real UI beside or below the illustration. The sprite itself contains no note, speech bubble, code, text, pen, or author badge.
frames: Exact neutral reference, paws relaxed.
Both paws move slightly inward toward the lower belly.
Paws lift just a little, preparing a small open presentation gesture.
Both paws gently open forward, palm-up, below the face; head inclines slightly toward the nearby real UI.
Brief, calm presentation hold; no flourish, floating object, or talking mouth.
Paws begin closing the presentation gesture.
Paws lower toward their original resting positions.
Exact neutral reference pose; copy the locked source.

clips.action: A small, polite raised-paw gesture and slightly more attentive eyes, followed by a return to neutral. No alarm, bouncing, red flash, exclamation symbol, bug, or accusing finger.
frames: Exact neutral reference, eyes open.
Viewer-right paw begins rising close to the chest; eyes become slightly more attentive.
Paw held politely at chest height with pads angled gently toward the viewer; head tips a tiny amount forward.
Quiet attention hold, no shock or panic face.
Paw lowers; head and eyes relax toward neutral.
Exact neutral reference pose; copy the locked source.

clips.action: One small affirmative nod with a warm, closed smile. Rotate the head a little; do not compress the entire body. No green check, thumbs-up, medal, confetti, or party pose.
frames: Exact neutral reference pose.
A barely perceptible preparation of the head for the nod; torso unchanged.
Head inclines downward a little; eyes remain naturally attentive.
Lowest point of one shallow nod, approximately three degrees; feet and belly unchanged.
Head begins rising from the nod.
Head almost level, smile still restrained.
Head settles, without a second nod or overshoot.
Exact neutral reference pose; copy the locked source.

clips.action: A slight inquisitive head tilt and a small open-paw gesture. Keep the emotional tone patient and capable. No crying, sweat drop, anger, broken-object prop, shrugging despair, or question mark.
frames: Exact neutral reference pose.
Head tilts gently toward the viewer's left; viewer-left paw begins to open near the belly.
Small open palm and about a three-degree head tilt, patient expression, eyes still friendly.
Quiet hold, inviting the user to inspect nearby real text and controls.
Head straightens and the paw closes toward its resting pose.
Exact neutral reference pose; copy the locked source.
